skin_points_hand_mesh: skin 3D hand mesh vertices using joint angles, rotation axes, and wrist transforms via linear blend skinning
get_skinning_weights_sparse: build a sparse skinning weight matrix from bone indices and weights for hand mesh deformation
axis_angle_to_rotation_matrix: convert axis-angle rotation vectors to 3x3 rotation matrices using Rodrigues formula
